title: Kelas Lima Amanah
subject: a twenty-year school reunion in the same hall
caption: Malay nostalgia pop built on a sampled texture. Opens on a looped cassette-hiss and wobble, then a clean band enters: brushed drum kit, warm electric piano with tremolo, a two-piece horn section playing short stabs, round electric bass. The intro is deliberately tape-degraded and narrow, the band sections open up clean and wide. Mixed male and female vocals trading lines and joining on the chorus, relaxed and unforced, smiling delivery. 104 BPM, B flat major. Warm, turning quiet at the end. No EDM drop, no trap drums, no autotune, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - cassette hiss and wobble]

[Verse 1 - Male Vocal]
Dewan sekolah sama, kipas sama, bunyi sama
Tapi lantai dah ganti, warna lain sikit
Cikgu Bahasa dah pakai tongkat
Dia masih ingat nama aku. Aku yang lupa nama dia.

[Pre-Chorus - Female Vocal]
Kami duduk ikut tempat lama
Tak ada orang suruh. Kami buat sendiri.

[Chorus - Duet]
Dua puluh tahun, dan kerusi tu masih tahu
Siapa duduk belakang, siapa duduk depan
Kami gelak kuat macam dulu
Lepas tu senyap, sebab kami dah tahu harga semua ni

[Verse 2 - Female Vocal]
Budak paling bising dah jadi orang paling senyap
Dia bawa anak. Anak dia bising. Adil.
Kami ambil gambar. Tiga kali.
Sebab ada satu orang tak senyum. Orang tu aku.

[Chorus - Duet]
Dua puluh tahun, dan kerusi tu masih tahu
Siapa duduk belakang, siapa duduk depan
Kami gelak kuat macam dulu
Lepas tu senyap, sebab kami dah bayar harga semua ni

[Outro - cassette stop]
Lampu dewan tutup satu-satu
